name: Baserate
vision: Crypto screeners show what matches today. BaseRate also shows what happened the last few thousand times — on two years of CoinMarketCap data.
description:
## The problem

Every crypto screener tells you what matches a rule today. None of them tell you if that rule has ever worked.

Traders chase patterns based on folklore — "rank climbers keep climbing", "volume spikes mean accumulation". BaseRate tests whether any of that is actually true.

## What it does

BaseRate is a backtested crypto screener built on two years of daily CoinMarketCap top-1000 snapshots (760 days, 688k token-days of history).

Pick any preset screen — or build your own with up to 8 conditions. Next to every screen you see its full track record: median return, hit rate, histogram, and how it compared to BTC on the same days.

**The results are often not what you'd expect.**

- Rank climbers (everyone chases these)? Median −4.9%, 37% hit rate. They underperform BTC.

- Blow-off tops shorted? Median +13.9%, **71% hit rate**. This one actually works.

## What you can do with it

- Instantly kill ideas that don't work before risking capital

- Find screens with real edge, not just pattern-matching noise

- Click any live match and see that token's full 2-year history, its own record with every preset, DEX wallet concentration, pool liquidity — and every API call with receipt

- Build custom screens on 15+ fields and get base rate back in under a second

## CMC API usage

Built on `/v1/cryptocurrency/listings/historical` for the archive (nightly refresh), `/v2/cryptocurrency/quotes/latest` for live prices, and DEX endpoints for on-chain tape. Every API call is shown to the user with endpoint, status and credits used.
